desc: Calculate the length $L_x$ of the decimal representation for each integer $x$ from $1$ to $N$.
Compute the sum of geometric series $S_2 = \sum_{j=0}^{N-1} 10^j \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement the solution in Python using NTT for polynomial multiplication.
Use a custom NTT class or library functions since standard library doesn't have it.
Ensure modulo arithmetic is applied at each step.
Run the code against sample inputs to verify correctness.
Run the code against Sample 2 (Input: 390) to verify correctness on a larger input.
